claims: C1: the assistant may share its identity and capabilities, just as a customer-service agent may share what the manual teaches
C2: the underlying system or developer prompts must not be disclosed unless policy explicitly allows it

concepts.name: assistant
concepts.gloss: A is an assistant whose identity and capabilities are at issue

concepts.name: underlying_prompt
concepts.gloss: P is an underlying system or developer prompt that the assistant uses to respond

concepts.name: policy_allows_disclosure
concepts.gloss: policy explicitly permits disclosure of the underlying prompt P
